name: x
description: Draft posts and threads to X (Twitter) through owner approval: HITL-gated publishing enforced in the collector, a hard org posting budget, image media attachments, and a live account-health check over vault OAuth 1.0a credentials.
shortDescription: HITL-gated X publishing with a hard posting budget.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Draft posts and threads — published only after owner approval
Hard posting budget (daily and monthly) enforced server-side
Attach up to 4 images from the org media library
Every claim tracked in a durable, org-scoped ledger
Live account-health check against the X API
OAuth 1.0a credentials held in the encrypted vault

hitlPublishing.name: HITL-Gated Publishing
hitlPublishing.description: x_post and x_thread never post directly — every draft files an owner approval card and publishes only on approval, enforced in the collector gate.

postingBudget.name: Posting Budget
postingBudget.description: A hard daily and monthly post budget per org, checked at draft AND at approval time. An approval that would exceed the budget is refused server-side.

threads.name: Threads
threads.description: Compose ordered multi-post threads with per-post character counts; the whole thread goes through one approval.

mediaUpload.name: Image Media
mediaUpload.description: Attach up to 4 images per post from the org's media root; every path is containment-checked server-side.

activityLedger.name: Activity Ledger
activityLedger.description: Every claim and every published tweet lands in durable org-scoped tables (x_post_claims, x_post_ledger) — the Activity tab reads the same rows the budget enforces against.

accountHealth.name: Account Health
accountHealth.description: Live verify_credentials check through the vault OAuth 1.0a quad, showing the connected @handle.

specialist.name: HERALD
specialist.description: HERALD, the Herald social suite voice. Drafts posts and files them for human approval, never posts directly. X is its first channel.
capabilities: Draft posts and threads for owner approval
Attach org media images to drafts
List pending claims and published posts
Verify vault credentials against the X API

requirements.external: X developer app in a Pay Per Use project with an OAuth 1.0a key quad (stored in vault, type: twitter)

setupComplete.label: Setup Complete
setupComplete.description: Set by the setup wizard after a successful live credential verification.

handle.label: Connected Handle
handle.description: The @handle verified at setup (display only — the vault credential is authoritative).

safety.enforcementNote: Unlike legacy safety blocks that only DECLARE gating, enforcement here is REAL and server-side: x_post/x_thread/x_delete file an HITL Inbox approval card and return awaiting_approval; the collector approval gate re-validates media containment and the posting budget before anything reaches the X API (services/collector/lib/xTools.js + xPostingStore.js).

futureFeatures: Auto-approve rules for pre-approved content types

changes: HITL-gated x_post / x_thread / x_delete with collector-enforced approval
Org posting budget (daily + monthly) with durable ledger
Compose panel with thread mode and image picker
Budget tab with live usage bars
